blocks.text: The frame below is a separate page that lives in `examples/cube/`. Any folder that has an `index.html` can be shown this way, so 3D scenes, canvas toys and plain HTML demos all fit. The page keeps your directory and header around it.

blocks.title: A spinning 3D cube drawn with CSS

blocks.text: Add your own: put a folder in `examples/`, then add an **Embed** block that points at `examples/your-folder/index.html`.
